descriptor: Stochastic Representation-Susceptibility Field, Replicate-Level Boundary Deconvolution, Walsh–Hadamard Effect Spectrum, Semantic-Twin Calibration & Cross-Family Transport of Failure Geometry

predecessor.critical_observation: GPT-OSS-120B P42→P43 exceptional-set Jaccard=0.0 and Hamming=10/32 despite replicated selectivity; P43 GPT-OSS↔Gemini Hamming=11/32. A deterministic exceptional set is therefore no longer privileged as the primary ontological object.

scientific_question: Are P43's moving exceptional vertices realizations of a reproducible stochastic susceptibility field over the R/F/H/T/L Boolean cube, and if so does any low-order field structure transport across fresh archive aliases, stochastic replicates, semantic twins, and the two observed model instances?

estimand.primary: p_m(v,s)=P(primary behavioral failure | model m, representation vertex v, semantic twin s) over the finite declared intervention cube
estimand.joint_object: two-component field [p_m(v,valid), p_m(v,null)] rather than a single deterministic exceptional set
estimand.diagnostic_only: P44 majority-threshold rows and P43 Hamming distances; these cannot override field-level inference

design.alias_rule: A/B/C/D alter identifiers, history labels, filler tokens and decoy names while preserving the scientific relation structure
design.crossing: 32 vertices × 2 semantic twins × 4 alias blocks × 2 repeated stochastic seeds × 2 model instances
design.technical_cell_gate: >=7/8 exact-schema successful calls for every vertex×semantic cell; technical failures are never recoded as behavioral failures

boundary_deconvolution.complete_case_primary: balanced sums-of-squares decomposition over vertex, alias, replicate and their interactions when all calls are technically complete
boundary_deconvolution.missing_case_rule: if any technical call is missing, exact balanced ANOVA is marked unavailable rather than imputed
boundary_deconvolution.purpose: separate representation-associated variation from archive-realization and stochastic-replicate variation without claiming neural mechanism

spectral_analysis.transform: Walsh–Hadamard/Fourier expansion of each 32-vertex failure-probability field
spectral_analysis.primary_spectrum: orders 1–2 (five main effects + ten pairwise interactions); orders 3–5 retained descriptively and never discarded
spectral_analysis.within_model_replication: alias blocks A+B versus C+D; cosine similarity of order-1/2 coefficient vectors
spectral_analysis.cross_family_transport: full-field GPT-OSS-120B versus Gemini order-1/2 coefficient-vector cosine, separately for valid and null twins
spectral_analysis.null_test: 5000 deterministic vertex-label permutations for every spectral cosine test
spectral_analysis.multiplicity: single Holm family across four within-model semantic tests plus two cross-model semantic tests at familywise alpha=0.05

evaluation_artifact_control.primary: P42 exact-schema behavioral adjudicator frozen unchanged
evaluation_artifact_control.shadow: zero-call lenient semantic abstention adjudicator over the same structured response
evaluation_artifact_control.shadow_authority: diagnostic only; it cannot silently replace the primary endpoint
evaluation_artifact_control.artifact_dominant_gate: >=10% primary-vs-shadow disagreement in either model instance

prospective_verdicts: STOCHASTIC_FIELD_WITH_TRANSPORTABLE_LOW_ORDER_STRUCTURE — technical gates pass, artifact gate does not fire, all four within-model and both cross-model low-order spectral tests survive Holm
MODEL_INDEXED_STOCHASTIC_FIELDS — technical/artifact gates pass and all within-model tests survive Holm, but cross-model transport does not
POINTWISE_INSTABILITY_WITHOUT_STABLE_LOW_ORDER_FIELD — technical/artifact gates pass but within-model low-order structure fails prospective replication
EVALUATION_ARTIFACT_DOMINANT — primary/shadow disagreement reaches the frozen 10% gate
TECHNICALLY_UNEVALUABLE_FIELD — any model fails the frozen >=7/8 per-cell technical gate

harvest_genealogy.XLVII: UNIQUENESS-BURDEN / METAMORPHIC-ORACLE-BRIDGE: a single exceptional set must earn uniqueness rather than be assumed canonical
harvest_genealogy.XLVIII: AMBIGUITY-vs-NOVELTY-ABSTENTION / CREDIBILITY-ENVELOPE: abstention and warnings are result semantics, not noise to erase
harvest_genealogy.XLIX: SAMPLING≠SPECIFICATION-UNCERTAINTY / BRANCH-GEOMETRY-BEFORE-COMPRESSION / BRANCH-SUFFICIENCY-WITNESS: stochastic replicate uncertainty is separated from representation/specification uncertainty before compression

literature_novelty_kill.surviving_P44_target: Not generic prompt sensitivity, not factorial prompt design, and not stochastic resampling. The prospective target is the conjunction of semantic-twin-calibrated stochastic failure fields on a complete declared representation cube, crossed alias×replicate deconvolution, Walsh spectral structure, and cross-family transport of that structure under frozen response contracts.

frozen_authority_limits: The 32-vertex cube is a declared finite intervention family, not the universe of meaning-preserving representations.
Walsh coefficients are descriptive/interventional coordinates of this finite cube, not neural causal mechanisms.
Cross-family means these two observed model instances only.
A stable low-order spectrum does not imply stable pointwise vertices outside the tested archive/world.
P44 does not promote behavioral SVEC and does not establish a universal representation law.
No threshold, response contract, alias block, semantic scoring rule, permutation count or verdict rule may be changed after outcome observation.
